_comment: Planned zones not yet built. Each will get a full JSON in data/zones/ and quests in data/quests/ using the same schema as the three existing zones.

stubs.name: Thornreach Coast
stubs.theme: Overgrown jungle coastline, troll-like ruins, pirate coves.

stubs.name: Graystone Hills
stubs.theme: Rocky highlands, dwarven-style digsites, gryphon roosts.

stubs.name: The Mirefen
stubs.theme: Vast swamp, sunken towers, oversized insects and oozes.

stubs.name: Shattered Steppe
stubs.theme: Broken badlands, warring ogre clans, buried titan machinery.

stubs.name: Frostpine Reach
stubs.theme: Snowbound pine forest, wendigo caves, abandoned keeps.

stubs.name: The Ashen Wastes
stubs.theme: Volcanic desert, cults of the burning below, glass storms.

stubs.name: Duskmourn
stubs.theme: Blighted dead forest, endgame elite camps, the Duskgate citadel.
